subject: Senior Inference Lead — exceptional comp approval request (Oliver Nguyen)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time Seniority premium + equity refresh for Oliver Nguyen (Sr Inference Lead)

Hi Ava / Marissa,

Candidate background in brief: Oliver Nguyen is a senior infra/LLM engineer currently at DataWave Analytics; strong ML infra pedigree (two production LLM deployments, author of an open-source KV cache micro-lib). He finished onsite last week. Feedback from hiring panel is unanimous — top of band for the role but has a competing offer at — and a salary + sign-on materially above our standard band.

Ask: to secure him were requesting an out-of-band sign-on and a one-time equity refresh on top of the standard offer. Proposed package (final numbers in attached comp_band_model.xlsx):
- Base: $215k (at top of band)
- Sign-on: $40,000 one-time cash
- Equity: standard RSU grant + 20% one-time refresh (accelerated cliff to be negotiated)

Rationale: direct competitor is offering $40k sign-on + accelerated vest on RSUs; candidate has strong infra-LLM experience that will reduce time-to-prod for several roadmap items (LLM caching + KV improvements). We think this is a make-or-break item.

Attachments: Oliver_Nguyen_Resume.pdf, comp_band_model.xlsx, candidate_offer_packet_v2.pdf

Requesting: Ava, can you approve the requested deviations (sign-on + equity refresh) or advise cap? If you need, we can route to Laurie/PeopleOps for final paperwork. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal, Model Ops
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time Seniority premium + equity refresh for Oliver Nguyen (Sr Inference Lead)

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and the attachments. Quick thoughts:
- Im comfortable approving up to $25k sign-on for this role out of my delegation. Anything above that needs VP-level sign-off.
- Equity refresh: I can pre-approve a one-time administrative refresh up to 15% (relative to initial grant) if PeopleOps confirms runway and dilution assumptions.

Marissa / Lauren, please confirm PeopleOps can process a 15% one-time refresh and whether comp_model numbers map to our target L7 package. If the candidate requires $40k sign-on, well need escalation to David/VPs; can you confirm availability for a quick review today?

If everyone agrees, Karthik please prepare a final offer packet and a short note we can use for VP escalation summarizing the business case.

- Ava
Director, Talent Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time Seniority premium + equity refresh for Oliver Nguyen (Sr Inference Lead)

Ava / Karthik —

Checked the comp model and ran quick dilution/board note templates. PeopleOps can execute up to 15% one-time equity refresh without board notification for candidates at L7 when justified. We can also issue a $25k sign-on under existing delegation.

For the extra $15k (to reach the requested $40k), we will need VP approval plus an accompanying business case memo (2 paragraphs) that quantifies expected impact (time to deliver two roadmap items, estimated dev hours saved, revenue/ops impact). If you can draft that Karthik, I will queue it for VP review this afternoon.

Also recommend giving Oliver a 30-day window to accept and a targeted start date of 2025-08-04.

Marissa
Head of People Operations

Attachment: peopleops_comp_guidelines_2025.pdf (see note on refresh approvals)
From: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@gmail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Emily Park <emily@talentgate.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer update / quick question

Hi Karthik / Emily,

Thanks for the update. I appreciate the team moving quickly. Two quick asks before I sign: 1) can the sign-on be $40k as my counter is time-limited, and 2) can the RSU vesting cliff be shortened to 18 months on the one-time refresh? Both are material to my decision.

Happy to chat for 15 minutes today if helpful. Looking forward to hearing back.

Best,
Oliver
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <emily@talentgate.io>, Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: escalation memo + candidate update (Oliver Nguyen)

Ava / Marissa / Lauren —

Per request, attached a short business case memo for VP review and a summary of expected impact. Asking for escalation approval to increase sign-on to $40k and to allow the one-time equity refresh with an 18-month accelerated cliff. If VP greenlights, PeopleOps to issue a revised offer and DocuSign link to Oliver (docusign link included below).

Summary (1-paragraph business case): Olivers experience integrating KV-caching layers and optimized batching into two production LLM systems is directly applicable to Priority Q3 roadmap items (prefix caching, 2x latency reduction target). Bringing him on accelerates estimated delivery by ~8-10 weeks which translates to an earlier launch of our higher-throughput serving path and expected cost savings for customers; this improvement reduces inference costs 10-15% on heavy workloads and is expected to improve renewal rates on several mid-market accounts.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/xyz-oliver-offer
Offer doc: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/PeopleOps/Offers/OLIVER-2025

Karthik
Principal, Model Ops
Attachment: OLIVER_vp_memo.pdf
